property_summary: For any caller and target owner address, only calls whose msg.sender equals the current owner may successfully change owner; the mutant that checks tx.origin instead can be bypassed by a contract caller so a call from a contract (msg.sender != owner) with tx.origin == owner will wrongly allow changing owner.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner require to compare against tx.origin instead of owner, altering who is authorized to call setOwner.
